title: [EPIC] Gaja as universal fediverse server — one backend, three API faces
description: Position gaja as the 'one server that does everything' — microblog + photos + videos from the same account, same identity, same server. Three API compatibility layers (Mastodon, Pixelfed, PeerTube) over one fieldwork backend. Multi-tenant: different tenants can have different personalities. The pitch: what Instagram+YouTube can't do, and what the fediverse should have been.
